title: grandma went off the volcano. i kept the kill.
author: MetalHorse233
selftext:
i made Black Wolves, a free-for-all Slayer starring armored babushkas on Cinder Station.

i built it on Spawn by talking with Savi. i started with just the arena, removed the support legs and put a kilometre of fog underneath. then came the babushkas. i wanted melee shoves to send them over the edge, arms flailing, and made sure the fall counted as the attacker's kill.

the first knock-off kill was mine. 8.6 hours from first message to publish.

free, play it in your browser: [https://www.spawn.co/@metalhorse233/black-wolves](https://www.spawn.co/@metalhorse233/black-wolves)
